title: When the Glasshouse Wakes
author: Lior Almeida
blurb: Bram Fairweather, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
